technique_name: Explain what a Java Statement is.
description: In Java, a statement is a language construct that is executed when the program runs. A statement is a logical instruction that tells the computer what action to take when it runs a program. Examples of statements include assignment statements, control flow statements, and declaration statements. An assignment statement assigns a value to a variable or an expression. Control flow statements are used to make decisions or loop through code blocks. Declaration statements declare variables and types.
